description: Phase 1: Forge 1.20.1 project scaffold, decisions docs (scale + prebuilt map production/distribution), verification tooling, pure-Java vehicle physics, hatchback 'Sao Mai' model/texture, vehicle entity with enter/exit/sync/HUD, self-contained geo renderer, mod camera modes (chase/classic/in-car/cinematic).
steps: Read .agents/inbox.md, then implement plan.md items 1.1-1.9 in order exactly as written in /projects/sandbox/Forzacraft/.agents/tasks/forzacraft/plan.md (files, behaviour, verification per item).
After each completed item: run its Verify command, then git add the specific files, commit (conventional message) and git push origin main.
Any point needing a user decision: append a question to .agents/questions.md, send_message severity 'info', mark the item DEFERRED (Qn) in plan.md, continue with other items.

Finish with the Phase 1 DONE CHECK: bash tools/ci/done-check.sh (and COMPAT=server bash tools/ci/server-smoke.sh where the plan says so); record command outputs summary, test counts, screenshot paths in findings.
acceptance_criteria: ./gradlew test passes incl. VehicleSimTest, GeoModelLoaderTest, CameraMathTest
runGameTestServer passes: car settles, drives >20 blocks in 5 s, mount/dismount
server-smoke exits 0 with and without COMPAT=server (Distant Horizons)
docs/decisions.md documents scale (x2 environment, refinements justified) and map production/distribution
Sao Mai screenshots in art/screenshots viewed and sized vs 1.8-block player
